newsitem.title: UK: Chelsea denies large share placing imminent.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea denies large share placing imminent.

text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, holding company for London football club Chelsea, said on Tuesday it was not currently in discussions "at an announceable stage" regarding a large share placing.
The company said it was making the statement in repsonse to recent press comments.
A report in the Mail on Sunday newspaper this weekend said that Chelsea was preparing to place another 10 million shares, raising at least 15 million pounds for the club.
The report said that Chelsea chairman Ken Bates was hoping to complete the sale this week, with the shares going to a single wealthy individual.
